title: 高盛CEO：全球权益市场160万亿，资本竞争如何影响定价？
speaker: David Solomon

segments.en: So investors see that. They're looking to participate. I think one of the things investors are trying to do is run broad, diversified portfolios. Debt investors are obviously paid to not make
segments.zh: 所以市场参与者看到了这一点。他们希望参与其中。我认为市场参与者试图做的一件事是构建广泛多元化的**组合。债务市场参与者显然被要求不犯错

segments.en: mistakes. And so if they think the market's getting a little bit more challenging, they ask for higher returns because debt investors don't get to make mistakes. Equity investors take more risk
segments.zh: 因此，如果他们认为市场变得更具挑战性，他们会要求更高的回报，因为债务市场参与者不能犯错。权益资产市场参与者承担更多风险

segments.en: because they look for upside. And I think there's still a lot of upside available as this technology gets built deployed and the application layer gets built over the next decade or two.
segments.zh: 因为他们寻求上行空间。我认为随着这项技术的构建、部署以及应用层在未来一二十年内的建立，仍有大量上行空间可供挖掘。

segments.en: The the size of the deals has grown substantially exponentially. Is there a theoretical ceiling or do you see the size of the deals being able to just continue to become larger and larger from
segments.zh: 交易规模已经大幅指数级增长。是否存在理论上的上限，或者您认为交易规模能够继续越来越大——从

segments.en: someone who puts these things together? Yeah, I think the constraint is not the amount of capital in the world and the size of these deals on a relative basis. Yes, there's no question. These deals
segments.zh: 整合这些交易的人的角度来看？是的，我认为限制因素不是全球资本的数量和这些交易的相对规模。是的，毫无疑问。这些交易

segments.en: are bigger and the capitalization of these companies is larger than what we've seen in other tech super cycles. But we also operate in a market that's much, much larger where equity market
segments.zh: 规模更大，这些公司的资本化程度也高于我们在其他科技超级周期中所见。但我们也在一个规模大得多的市场中运作，其中权益市场

segments.en: cap has grown very substantially. Public equity market cap in the world is about 160 trillion.
segments.zh: 市值已大幅增长。全球公开权益市场市值约为160万亿美元。

segments.en: And so there's a lot of capital out there to support this growth. I think sometimes investors or the dialogue around this gets confused between risk reward and what's the appropriate pricing
segments.zh: 因此有大量资本支持这一增长。我认为有时市场参与者或相关对话会混淆风险回报与某些风险的适当定价

segments.en: for certain kinds of risk and how that pricing parameter can change and the short run as the market moves around versus whether capital is available. But there's no question. These numbers are big
segments.zh: 以及该定价参数在市场波动中短期内如何变化，与资本是否可用之间的区别。但毫无疑问。这些数字很大

segments.en: and also capital is competitive to some degree. Rates are higher, governments around the world are issuing more debt. That's a competitive factor in all this but I don't think it affects
segments.zh: 而且资本在一定程度上具有竞争性。利率更高，全球各国政府发行更多债务。这是所有这一切中的竞争因素，但我认为它不会影响

segments.en: availability. I think it affects cost and if cost goes up too much, it changes. You know, there are turns in some of these projects and that will change the way some of this happens
segments.zh: 可用性。我认为它会影响成本，如果成本上升太多，就会改变。你知道，其中一些项目会有转折，这将改变某些事情的发生方式

segments.en: in the way it's financed. And here in Asia, I mean, you guys have had a really record run.
segments.zh: 以及融资方式。在亚洲，你们经历了创纪录的行情。
